content.text: ReachWeaver release notes for our Page.

notes: Links in Page posts stay as typed; ReachWeaver adds none.

media.constraints_reference: reachweaver/media.py CONSTRAINTS (targets: facebook); run media-check MANIFEST

account_eligibility.item: Signed in to the intended Facebook Pages account: (not supplied)
Target is a Facebook Page you manage (declared: page); never a personal profile or group

api_capability.reason: facebook text is api_gated; publish refused (fail closed)

target.note: Page posts use a Page access token from a person who can perform CREATE_CONTENT, MANAGE and MODERATE tasks on the Page.

personal_profile.note: The User feed reference states that creating a post is not possible on this endpoint.

groups.note: Groups API permissions, including publish_to_groups, were removed from all versions on 2024-04-22.

text_max_chars.note: Not stated on the fetched page; ReachWeaver applies its conservative cap from policy.py instead.

media_constraints.note: No Facebook table in reachweaver/media.py yet.

notice: MANUAL EXPORT ONLY. ReachWeaver has not sent, uploaded, scheduled or shared anything on Facebook Pages. This package is not evidence that a post exists. The account holder decides whether to post it, in the platform's own app.
checklist: Verify every claim against its cited source (campaign-check / claims-check); this package does not prove anything is true.
Signed in to the intended Facebook Pages account: (not supplied)
Target is a Facebook Page you manage (declared: page); never a personal profile or group
Paste caption.txt into Facebook Pages exactly; do not let tools add text, links or watermarks.
Confirm rights, consent and disclosure for all text and media.
If you post it, copy the post's link from the app and keep it: that link is the proof the post exists. ReachWeaver records nothing from this package.
